show:241609.title: Your Friends & Neighbors
show:241609.window: no date announced; Seasons 1-2 both premiered in April, so April 2027 is a plausible guess, not confirmed
show:241609.source: Variety, Deadline, TVLine (Apr-Jun 2026) — renewed ahead of the Season 2 premiere; Joshua Jackson and Michelle Monaghan join the cast

show:247522.title: Tires
show:247522.source: Variety, Deadline, Hollywood Reporter (Aug 2026) — renewed ~2 weeks after Season 3 premiered, following its record Netflix Top 10 run

show:199318.title: Bad Sisters
show:199318.window: not renewed as of this check; creator Sharon Horgan says she'll only return with a genuinely new story, not just "women kill again"
show:199318.source: IMDb, ScreenRant, TheReviewGeek (through Feb 2026) — no Apple TV+ renewal announcement found

show:243316.title: The Four Seasons
show:243316.source: Variety, TVLine, Netflix Tudum (mid-June 2026) — 8-episode Season 3 renewal announced after the Season 2 release

show:206828.title: DTF St. Louis
show:206828.window: no Season 2 confirmed — was billed as a single-season limited series; an EP has floated an anthology-style continuation as an idea, not an announcement

show:254953.title: Rooster
show:254953.window: no date announced; filming began August 2026, a 2027 premiere is possible per reporting

show:250307.title: The Pitt
show:250307.window: not yet officially dated by HBO Max, but multiple outlets expect Thursday, January 7, 2027 (Season 1 and 2 both premiered in January)
show:250307.source: TVLine, TVGuide, Forbes (renewed Jan 7, 2026, the same day the Season 2 finale aired)

show:245927.title: Paradise
show:245927.window: no date announced; confirmed as the intended final season
show:245927.source: Hollywood Reporter, TheWrap, Variety (renewed Mar 17, 2026, mid-way through Season 2's run)

show:225171.title: Pluribus
show:225171.window: no date announced; writing is done, filming expected to start fall 2026 — Season 1 took ~21 months from its own filming start to release, so a 2027 or later premiere is likely
show:225171.source: Forbes, Collider, ScreenRant (Aug 2026) — Apple TV committed to a 2-season order upfront; Vince Gilligan says he's planning 3-4 seasons total

show:246386.title: All Her Fault
show:246386.window: no date announced; filming in New York, summer 2026
show:246386.source: TheCinemaholic, Parade, Yahoo (Dec 2025-ish renewal) — a genuine surprise, since it was originally billed as a miniseries adaptation of Andrea Mara's novel

show:271053.title: I Love LA
show:271053.window: no exact date; HBO has projected a Fall 2026 release
show:271053.source: TVInsider, Marie Claire, PrimeTimer (renewed Nov 20, 2025 at the HBO/HBO Max slate presentation, after only 3 of 8 Season 1 episodes had aired)

show:250923.title: Nobody Wants This
show:250923.window: no exact date; Netflix says 2026, and Kristen Bell has teased "September, October... sometime this fall" — already in production as of spring 2026

show:112211.title: Platonic
show:112211.source: TVLine, Variety, Deadline, Apple TV Press (renewed Dec 5, 2025)

show:117581.title: Ginny & Georgia
show:117581.window: explicitly pushed to 2027, not 2026 — Netflix confirmed the delay with no specific window given; filming wrapped March 2026

show:120998.title: Poker Face
show:120998.window: canceled by Peacock after Season 2 — no Season 3 at Peacock. Creator Rian Johnson is shopping the show to other outlets for a possible 2-season order, reportedly with Peter Dinklage replacing Natasha Lyonne as lead — nothing confirmed
show:120998.source: IMDb, Deadline via ScreenRant, E! Online, CBR (2026)

show:124101.title: Hacks
show:124101.window: Season 5 (the confirmed final season) aired April 9 - May 28, 2026 — the series is genuinely over, not just between seasons

show:111803.title: The White Lotus
show:111803.window: no date announced; production began April 15, 2026 in Saint-Tropez, France — projections suggest late January 2027

show:99353.title: Love is Blind
show:99353.window: no exact date; Netflix has announced a Fall 2026 window for this Boston-set season (the US flagship format, not one of the international spin-offs)
show:99353.source: Variety, Newsweek, Marie Claire (2026 upfronts announcement)
